description: This Java class implements a custom type filter used in Spring to conditionally include beans based on the presence and attributes of an annotation @OpenmrsProfile. It is designed to include beans for certain OpenMRS profiles, specifically creating beans for versions 1.8 and later, and excluding for 1.6 to 1.7.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileIncludeFilter
classes.description: Implements Spring's TypeFilter to include beans if the @OpenmrsProfile annotation matches specific criteria, leveraging an internal exclude filter.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Decides whether to include a bean based on OpenmrsProfile annotation attributes. Returns true if the profile matches the criteria for inclusion, specifically for OpenMRS 1.8 and later profiles.
